description: This PHP source file provides the backend logic, HTML structure, and embedded JavaScript for the second step of a web-based home network Wi-Fi configuration wizard. It includes form handling for Wi-Fi network names, security settings, passwords for both 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz bands, and associated validation and UI behaviors.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends AJAX request to save the Wi-Fi configuration data, then provides UI feedback based on response.

methods.name: click_save
methods.description: Collects form data, constructs a JSON configuration object, and invokes set_config to save Wi-Fi settings.
